changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: MODELING_PLAN_VERSION_REVIEW_RETIREMENT_BLOCKED: empty both tables and remove unknown foreign-key or view dependencies before deployment
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_plan_review) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_plan_version)

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND ( ( c.conrelid = 'modeling_plan_review'::regclass AND c.confrelid = 'modeling_plan'::regclass AND c.conname = 'fk_modeling_plan_review_plan' ) OR ( c.conrelid = 'modeling_plan_version'::regclass AND c.confrelid = 'modeling_plan'::regclass AND c.conname = 'fk_modeling_plan_version_plan' ) )

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND ( c.confrelid IN ( 'modeling_plan_review'::regclass, 'modeling_plan_version'::regclass ) OR ( c.conrelid IN ( 'modeling_plan_review'::regclass, 'modeling_plan_version'::regclass ) AND c.conname NOT IN ( 'fk_modeling_plan_review_plan', 'fk_modeling_plan_version_plan' ) ) )

SELECT count(DISTINCT dependent_view.oid) FROM pg_depend dependency JOIN pg_rewrite rewrite_rule ON rewrite_rule.oid = dependency.objid JOIN pg_class dependent_view ON dependent_view.oid = rewrite_rule.ev_class WHERE dependency.refobjid IN ( 'modeling_plan_review'::regclass, 'modeling_plan_version'::regclass ) AND dependent_view.relkind IN ('v', 'm')

changeSet.comment: Remove the empty legacy plan review and version ledgers after their Java APIs and repositories have been retired. Unknown relational dependencies halt the deployment instead of cascading.
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE modeling_plan, modeling_plan_review, modeling_plan_version IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE
